svg.aria-label: Move a list element, in memory. Move the element at a random index to another random index — the element itself, merged once. Nothing touches the disk. ops/s, log scale, higher is better. Not shown: syncom (the pure build: only its text is typed through openText()); Yjs (no move); Automerge (no move); TinyBase (no list that merges by position); PouchDB (no list that merges by position); RxDB (no list that merges by position); Fireproof (no list that merges by position); GUN (needs its storage adapter to answer in Node.js); OrbitDB (no list that merges by position).
